get.description: A stream of events as they happen, after replaying the saved ones that come after `after` (or after the `Last-Event-ID` header, whichever is higher). Each message has only `id` (the seq) and `data` (the event as JSON, a `RunEvent`). There is no `event:` line: the type is `data.type`, so read the stream with `EventSource.onmessage`. A listener for a named event would never fire. The stream ends after `run_finished`. Connecting to a finished run with nothing left to replay answers 204, so a browser's EventSource stops trying again. Answers 404 for an unknown run and 429 when too many people are watching.
